title: The First Utterance
description: The Ainul speak a single name into the unmeasured dark, and creation acquires a boundary.

title: The Sundering
description: The original light divides into sovereign aspects. White and Black awaken on opposite shores of reality.

title: The Red March
description: Red crosses the mortal kingdoms and every standing army declares allegiance or turns upon itself.

title: The Ashen Concord
description: White and Black enter the same sealed archive. Grey emerges after seven silent days.

title: Fall of the Verdant Throne
description: The Beast consumes the Fifth Keeper's name, leaving a vacancy no prophecy had recorded.
